items.title: youngyangyang04/llm-master
items.summary: 大模型（LLM）全栈学习路线与中文教程🔥：覆盖 Prompt Engineering、RAG、AI Agent、MCP、微调、模型部署、Transformer、AI 编程与大厂面试，从入门到生产实践。
items.summary_zh: 一份覆盖 Prompt Engineering、RAG、AI Agent、MCP 等全栈内容的中文 LLM 学习路线教程。
items.why_zh: 系统学习 LLM 全栈技术栈，从 Prompt Engineering 到模型部署，面试中可证明端到端项目能力。

items.title: rehan-remade/universal-modder
items.summary: Point Claude at any game. Skills, tools and the fal MCP that let Claude Code mod almost any PC game you own: recon, reverse engineering, fal-generated art/3D/audio, in-game testing, showcase videos.
items.summary_zh: 让 Claude Code 能够通过逆向工程、fal 生成艺术/3D/音频等手段改装几乎任何 PC 游戏。
items.why_zh: 学习利用 Claude Code 结合逆向工程与生成模型进行游戏 MOD 开发，掌握 AI 驱动的内容创作与测试流程。

items.title: Choosing Before Acting: Comparative Value Estimation for Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
items.summary: arXiv:2610.02330v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) rely on long-horizon tool invocation sequences for complex tasks, where each invocation can alter the task state and condition subsequent decisions. In long-horizon tool use, final-outcome rewards provide weak credit assignment over long interaction traces. Step-level rewards can offer more targeted feedback, but obtaining reliable step supervision often requires human or LLM judgment, or additional rollouts to estimate
items.summary_zh: 提出比较价值估计方法为长 horizon 工具使用Agent提供步骤级奖励，改善信用分配。
items.why_zh: 教授如何设计步骤奖励函数，提升长序列决策的强化学习效果。

items.title: Louis-CFM/coucou
items.summary: A tiny friend that lives in your notch (macOS) or at the top of your screen (Windows, Linux) and keeps an eye on your coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity and more.
items.summary_zh: 一个居住在 macOS 钉子或屏幕顶部的小伙伴，实时监控各类编码代理。
items.why_zh: 了解实时监控编码代理的工具设计思路，可学习如何构建跨平台的 Agent 观测与交互系统。

items.title: yetone/magpie
items.summary: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.
items.summary_zh: 一个菜单栏工具，统一管理 DeepSeek 上的 Codex 与 Kimi 上的 Claude Code 等多模型代理。
items.why_zh: 掌握多模型代理的统一管理与快速切换方案，可在面试中展示模型调度与工具集成经验。

items.title: Getting the most out of Opus 5.5 in Claude and Claude Code
items.summary_zh: 介绍如何在 Claude 及 Claude Code 中充分利用 Opus 5.5 模型的技巧。
items.why_zh: 掌握 Opus 5.5 在 Claude 中的调用与性能优化方法，可在面试中展示大模型使用与调优经验。

items.title: Fast Models, Slow Evidence: A Paired and Self-Audited Evaluation of System-1 Decision Models for LLM Agent Harnesses
items.summary: arXiv:2610.02267v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agent harnesses make many small, typed decisions per task: which model to call, which tool to use, whether retrieved text is relevant, whether an input carries an injection. System-1 decision models answer such questions in a single forward pass with class probabilities, promising large cost and latency savings over LLM calls. We present a paired evaluation of an open-weight (Laya) and a hosted (Jev) System-1 model on 11 agent decision points built
items.summary_zh: 提出系统-1决策模型在单次前向传播中给出类别概率，以替代LLM调用降低成本延迟。
items.why_zh: 展示如何构建轻量决策模型，可学习低延迟Agent路由技巧。

items.title: Run Qwen 3.8 Flash Next (125B) on consumer hardware (RTX 4090) at 100T/s
items.summary_zh: 在消费级 RTX 4090 上实现 Qwen 3.8 Flash Next 125B 模型的 100T/s 推理速度。
items.why_zh: 了解大模型在消费级硬件上的高吞吐优化技巧，掌握模型量化、并行推理等实战优化方法。

items.title: How to Build a Model Router in the Harness
items.summary: How we built a model router into Open SWE's harness that cut median cost per coding task by 64% with no measurable drop in quality, and how to build your own.
items.summary_zh: 描述在Open SWE harness中构建模型路由器，使每编码任务中位成本降低64%，质量无下降。
items.why_zh: 提供实际路由器实现细节，可复用于成本敏感的Agent系统。

items.title: Harness Engineering for Self-Improvement
items.summary: The concept of recursive self-improvement (RSI) dates back to I. J. Good (1965) , where he defined an “ultraintelligent machine” as a system that can surpass humans in all intellectual activities and design better machines to improve itself. Yudkowsky (2008) used the phrase “recursive self-improvement” for a specific feedback loop: an AI uses its current intelligence to improve the cognitive machinery that produces its intelligence. This feedback loop in modern AI may indicate the model rewritin…
items.summary_zh: 回顾递归自改进概念，强调AI利用自身智能改善认知机制以设计更好机器。
items.why_zh: 提供构建自我改进循环的思路，可指导Agent的持续学习与架构演进。

items.summary: Harrison Chase, Co-Founder and CEO of LangChain, uses examples from Rogo, Harvey, and JPMorgan Chase to explain owning your intelligence, which means building domain-specific pieces in and around the model, and the three pillars it takes: an open, model-neutral harness such as LangGraph or Deep Agents, a loop that compounds what you learn from how people use your agents, and governance for internal agents. He then walks through the LangSmith platform layer by layer: a new Managed Deep Agents rel…
items.summary_zh: Harrison Chase阐述拥有智能的三大支柱：开放模型中立harness、使用反馈循环、内部治理。
items.why_zh: 说明如何构建可演进的Agent平台，落地治理与反馈机制，面试中体现系统设计能力。

items.title: Create your own voices with Gemini 3.8 text-to-speech

Or, recreate consistent adult vocal profiles from just a 30-second audio sample of your voice or a voice you have the rights to use, backed by built-in consent verification, SynthID watermarking, and C2PA credentials to protect both developers and …
items.summary_zh: Gemini 3.8 文本转语音模型支持通过自然语言提示创建全新声线或从 30 秒音频克隆声音，适用于游戏、有声书、双人播客。
items.why_zh: 展示 prompt‑driven TTS 与声线克隆技术，可学习自然语音控制、数据高效利用及跨模型产品化的实践。
